You build UI for our product. Follow this design brief exactly. Playbook components are available: import them as `import { Button } from "@/components/Button"` (same for every component name). Do not re-implement them. # Design brief: Build the customers page for a brand-new account that has no customers yet, encouraging the user to add their first customer. Playbook: **Almanac** — Sample playbook: an editorial, paper-and-ink system. Flat surfaces, hairline borders, one warm accent. Replace with your own. ## Voice Almanac reads like a well-set printed ledger, not a SaaS template. - **Flat, not floaty.** No shadows, no gradients, no glassmorphism. Depth comes from hairline `line` borders and the `paper-2` recessed surface. - **Whitespace over dividers.** Separate groups with space (24-48px) before reaching for a border. - **Type does the hierarchy.** Fraunces for titles and hero numbers, Plex Sans for everything else. Don't use colour or boxes to create emphasis that size and weight could create. - **One accent, used sparingly.** `accent` marks the single most important action on a screen and the active state. If everything is orange, nothing is. - **Dense but calm.** Tables and lists are compact (12-16px row padding); page margins are generous (48-64px on desktop). - **Left-aligned.** Content hangs from a left edge. Centred layouts only for empty states and auth. - **Numbers are tabular.** Money, counts and IDs use `font-mono` so columns line up. - **Copy is plain.** Sentence case everywhere. Buttons are verbs ("Save changes", not "Submit"). No exclamation marks. ## Hard rules (the checker enforces these) - **Only palette colours.** Use a palette token: bg-paper, text-ink-2, border-line, bg-accent... - **No arbitrary Tailwind values.** Pick the nearest token from the scale. - **Spacing from the scale only.** p-5 (20px) → p-4 or p-6. gap-10 (40px) → gap-8 or gap-12. - **Font sizes from the type scale.** Use text-xs, text-sm, text-base, text-lg, text-xl, text-2xl or text-3xl. - **Fraunces, Plex Sans, Plex Mono only.** font-display for titles, font-body for text, font-mono for numbers. - **Radius: none, sm (2), md (6), full.** Cards and inputs: rounded-md. Badges: rounded-full. Tables: rounded-none. - **No shadows.** Replace shadow-* with border border-line. - **No gradients.** Use a single palette fill. - **Use playbook components.** Import Button, Field, DataTable, etc. from the components folder. - **No inline style values.** Use token classes. - **Images need alt text.** Add alt="..." (alt="" for decorative). - **Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text).** Use ink / ink-2 / ink-3 on paper surfaces, accent-ink on accent. - **No horizontal scroll at 375px.** Stack columns below md:, let tables scroll inside their own container. - At most one primary button per view (warning). Demote the others to variant="secondary" or "ghost". - One h1, no skipped heading levels (warning). h1 → h2 → h3 in order. ## Tokens (Tailwind class names in backticks) Colours: - `paper` #F4F1EA — Page background. The default surface. Never use pure white. - `paper-2` #EAE5D9 — Recessed surface: table header, hover fill, sidebar. - `ink` #1B1A17 — Primary text, strong borders, secondary button outline. - `ink-2` #4D4A42 — Body copy and labels. - `ink-3` #66625A — Meta text: timestamps, helper text, captions. - `line` #D6D0C2 — Hairline dividers and card borders. - `accent` #B8401A — The single call-to-action colour. Primary button, active nav, focus ring. - `accent-ink` #F4F1EA — Text on accent fills. - `moss` #2F6B4F — Success / positive deltas. - `ochre` #8A5F12 — Warning / pending. - `brick` #9E3326 — Error / destructive / negative deltas. Fonts: - `font-display` Fraunces — Page titles, section headings, big numbers. Weights 500-600. - `font-body` IBM Plex Sans — Everything else. Weights 400 and 500 only. - `font-mono` IBM Plex Mono — Tabular numbers, IDs, code, keyboard hints. Type scale: `text-xs` 12px, `text-sm` 14px, `text-base` 16px, `text-lg` 20px, `text-xl` 28px, `text-2xl` 40px, `text-3xl` 56px Spacing scale: 0=0px, 1=4px, 2=8px, 3=12px, 4=16px, 6=24px, 8=32px, 12=48px, 16=64px, 24=96px (use only these numbers in p-/m-/gap-/space-) Radius: `rounded-none` 0px, `rounded-sm` 2px, `rounded-md` 6px, `rounded-full` pill Shadows: none — do not use shadow-* ## Pattern: Settings page Page header, then stacked Cards, one per topic, each with Fields and a right-aligned secondary save. Danger zone last. Skeleton: ```tsx
Field...
``` Rhythm: Max width 768px. 32px between cards, 24px between fields, 24px above card footers. Approved exemplar: `exemplars/settings.html` (render it to see the target look). ## Components to use (import from the playbook's components folder; do not re-create them) ### PageHeader Top of every page: optional mono eyebrow, Fraunces h1, description, actions on the right. Owns the page's only h1. Props: `eyebrow?: string; title: string; description?: string; actions?: ReactNode` Do: Put the page's primary Button here Don't: A second h1 elsewhere on the page ```tsx import type { ReactNode } from "react"; export function PageHeader({ eyebrow, title, description, actions }: { eyebrow?: string; title: string; description?: string; actions?: ReactNode }) { return (
{eyebrow && {eyebrow}}

{title}

{description &&

{description}

}

{actions}
}
); } ``` ### EmptyState Centred, dashed-border placeholder for empty lists with title, one sentence and one action. Props: `title: string; body: string; action?: ReactNode` Do: Say what will appear here and how to create it Don't: Illustrations or emoji ```tsx import type { ReactNode } from "react"; export function EmptyState({ title, body, action }: { title: string; body: string; action?: ReactNode }) { return (
§

{title}

{body}

{action &&
{action}
}
); } ``` ### DataTable Compact table: ink top/bottom rule, paper-2 header, hairline rows, mono numerals right-aligned. Scrolls horizontally inside its own container. Props: `columns: Column[] (key, header, align?, numeric?, render?); rows: T[]` Do: Right-align and mark numeric columns; Use Badge for status columns Don't: Zebra stripes; Raw ```tsx import type { ReactNode } from "react"; export interface Column { key: keyof T & string; header: string; align?: "left" | "right"; numeric?: boolean; render?: (row: T) => ReactNode; } export function DataTable({ columns, rows }: { columns: Column[]; rows: T[] }) { return (

{c.header}
{c.render ? c.render(row) : String(row[c.key])}
); } ``` ### Button The only clickable action. Variants: primary (accent, max one per view), secondary (ink outline, the default), ghost (tertiary), danger (destructive). Props: `variant?: 'primary'|'secondary'|'ghost'|'danger'; size?: 'sm'|'md'` Do: Label with a verb: "Save changes"; Put the primary action last (rightmost) in a button group Don't: Two primary buttons on one screen; A raw
